items.title: GE Vernova Offers Quick Solution To AI's Power Turbine Quandary
items.summary: AI data centers have, for various reasons, become a focal story for stock market investors.  As a result, orders for gas turbines, the primary method of providing such power loads, are backed up until 2031.  Complicating the picture is that artificial intelligence programs create steeply uneven power demands.

items.title: AI Data Centers Need More Power and Bloom Energy Could Be a Big Winner
items.summary: Hyperscalers are scrambling for power that the grid simply cannot deliver fast enough, and one fuel cell company just reported a 165% revenue surge while its stock sits 12% off its peak. The question is whether the selloff is a warning or a window.

items.title: GE Vernova vs. American Electric Power: Which Power Stock Has the Edge?
items.summary: Both GEV and AEP are positioned to benefit from surging electricity demand, AI data centers, and the massive U.S. grid expansion.

items.title: Falling, Falling, Falling: Why One of Wall Street’s Biggest Ratings Agencies Expects Bloom Energy to Explode 70% Higher
items.summary: Bloom Energy just posted one of the cleanest quarters in the AI infrastructure space, yet its stock sits 42% below its recent peak. One major Wall Street firm is doubling down with a price target that leaves every analyst on the Street standing alone.

items.title: This Week In Energy Transition - Solar Market Soars: Innovations Drive Global Growth

items.title: Why Is GE Vernova (GEV) A Key Pick For Queensland's Supernode Battery Project?
items.summary: GE Vernova (NYSE:GEV) has been selected as a key technology partner for stage three of the Queensland Supernode BESS grid scale battery project in Australia. The contract centers on advanced grid connectivity and large scale battery energy storage systems for the Queensland power network. The project has secured Generator Performance Standards acceptance, a major regulatory step for connecting to the Australian grid. items.title: GE Vernova Launches Medium-Voltage Power System for AI Data Centers
items.summary: GE Vernova Inc. (NYSE:GEV) has introduced a new medium-voltage uninterruptible power supply designed to meet the growing electricity requirements of data centers, artificial intelligence infrastructure and other power-intensive facilities.

items.title: GE Vernova to supply technology for stage three of Supernode BESS project
items.summary: Supernode’s first and second stages, which are now fully operational, also used GE Vernova technology.
